title: every word on screen is lower case
why: His order (2026-10-18): change all text shown to the player to lowercase only, he does not like random words capitalized. Every canvas line, measure, text node and tooltip already passes one text door (ncFix), so that door now lowers everything, acronyms and key names too. The few words the stylesheet writes itself (the Esc Resume and pad hint strips) are lowered by one CSS line.
now: Every word on screen is now lower case, everywhere.
